generatedBy: DraftOps Sequential Dynamic Pick Audit Script
method: For each pick, score every remaining candidate from the 123-player local pool, apply dynamic team preference / feature / sequencing adjustments, select the top candidate, remove him, then continue.

scenario.label: balanced baseline
scenario.whenToUse: Default first board before late breaking news.

variant.label: DeepSeek LLM parameter rerun
rationale: Adopts mild base to preserve late-round stability (picks 27-30) seen in mild run, avoiding the disruption caused by guard rail penalties.

Athletic deficit penalty reduced from 1.0 to 0.9 to slightly decrease sensitivity to low explosiveness scores, reducing volatility in prospects like Yaxel Lendeborg (explosiveness 6.3) who appeared in pick 10 margin.
Weak preference cap and feature positive cap kept at mild levels (3.25, 1.15) as they balance team fit without over-amplifying pick value adjustments.
D-tier additional penalty kept low (0.35) to avoid punishing data-incomplete prospects excessively, which in guard run led to tail end reshuffling.

guardrails.schoolStatePriorPolicy: Only apply configured, data-backed priors. None are configured in this run.
